roles.whole_expression: Close adult lifestyle photography, candid cotton/skin contact and a short confident editorial heading. A modest useful exchange, with unequal image/type responsibilities.

nearest_distinction.comparison: With colour/material removed, M1 keeps one full-height left scene and one continuous right information column, plus a one-line upper-left name. M4 keeps opposed corner vignettes, a compact two-line name and a central-to-lower-right factual step. M1 makes close object contact the evidence; M4 makes the shared adult table the whole spatial context.

roles.whole_expression: Bright contemporary civic graphics: precise flat illustration, strong calendar hierarchy, direct headings and three practical stations. Accessible mainstream communication with adult proportions.

nearest_distinction.comparison: M2 remains date-first with an ordered full-width three-part image band and three same-baseline stations. M5 remains English-masthead-first with one compact upper-right comparison graphic and unequal lower attendance/participation blocks. M2 explains by sequence; M5 identifies through a bold emblem and asymmetry.

roles.whole_expression: Graphic textile assemblage with oblique photographed cotton planes, strong coherent fabric rhythm and peripheral utility type. Flat poster, not catalogue or wall mockup.

nearest_distinction.comparison: M3 retains opposing image corners, a central linking title and diagonal fact islands when fabric/colour is removed. M2 retains date-led upper-left entry, a horizontal ordered image band and three bottom stations. Interrupted diagonal material relationships versus direct sequence change the image responsibility and retrieval geometry.

roles.whole_expression: Warm opaque gouache-like illustration with economical ink contours and diagonal communal-table space. Ordinary adult figures and generosity supply the invitation.

nearest_distinction.comparison: These are closest because both have left Korean identity and upper-right sharing imagery. Removing colour/material shows M4 still has a source garment in the lower-left, exchange in the upper-right, a compact name at the top and facts stepping through the centre into lower-right. M5 has a full-width English masthead, source/result/sharing combined in one upper-right emblem, Korean identity beneath the masthead, attendance low on the left and participation low on the right. M4 uses a connected adult table scene to organise the entire space; M5 uses a compact comparative graphic within a strong asymmetric typographic broadside.

roles.whole_expression: Flat high-contrast stencil/ink graphic, decisive negative space, sparse form-bound halftone and broad typographic masthead. Energetic public invitation without raised type or glossy hero.

nearest_distinction.comparison: Despite shared left Korean identity and upper-right sharing cues, M5 remains English-masthead-first with one combined source/result/offering emblem, low-left attendance and low-right participation. M4 remains Korean-name-first with large source garment lower-left, adult exchange upper-right and a central-to-right factual step. M5 gives the graphic a compact emblem role and type a broadside role; M4 gives the shared adult table responsibility for the full diagonal space. Colour/material removal leaves those different image locations, first/next cues and retrieval paths intact.
nearest_distinction.other_close_comparison: M2 instead starts with date, uses three ordered image scenes across the width and three equal-baseline practical stations; M5 uses a single emblem and unequal clusters.

scope: Prospective planning geometry only; font/source observations and future native results remain distinct.
